Internal handler dispatcher: bcfp/user_habitat_classification

Source: R/crt_handler_bcfp_user_habitat_classification.R
crt_handler_bcfp_user_habitat_classification.Rd

Called by crt_ingest() via the registry's handler_fn lookup. Dispatches on variant_id (matched upstream from schema YAML) to the appropriate normalization path. Returns canonical wide-shape tibble.

Usage

crt_handler_bcfp_user_habitat_classification(raw, variant_id)

Arguments

raw

A data frame returned by readr::read_csv() against the source CSV.

variant_id

Character. The upstream variant id matched by crt_ingest() against the schema YAML. One of: "2026-04-26-wide", "pre-2026-04-26-long".

Value

A tibble in canonical wide shape (per inst/extdata/schemas/bcfp/user_habitat_classification.yaml).

Details

Not exported. See crt_ingest() for the public API.
